---
title: "Filtered Phenotype Heatmap and Dendrogram"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(here)
library(pheatmap)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

source(here("Scripts", "00_visualization_prep.R"))
load(here("Outputs", "photophys_preprocessed_data2.RData"))

plot_dir <- here("Plots")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir) && !dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)) {
  stop("Could not create the Plots directory: ", plot_dir)
}
```

```{r sanger-ids}
sanger_raw <- read_csv(
  here("Data", "D_trenchii_Sanger_seqIDs.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

confirmed_trenchii_ids <- sanger_raw %>%
  pull(Name) %>%
  str_replace("_[A-H]\\d{2}\\.ab1$", "") %>%
  str_replace("\\.ab1$", "") %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_replace("algo", "aglo") %>%
  str_replace("^t(\\d+)_?([a-z]+)_?(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2_\\3") %>%
  str_to_upper() %>%
  purrr::keep(~ str_detect(.x, "^\\d+_[A-Z]+_\\d+$")) %>%
  unique()
```

```{r heatmap}
my_hclust <- fit_cbb2$hclust
original_labels <- my_hclust$labels

heatmap_matrix <- t(permanova_matrix_filtered2)
sample_match <- match(original_labels, colnames(heatmap_matrix))
if (anyNA(sample_match)) {
  stop("Some dendrogram labels are missing from permanova_matrix_filtered2.")
}
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, sample_match, drop = FALSE]

heatmap_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix)))
heatmap_matrix_scaled[is.na(heatmap_matrix_scaled) | is.nan(heatmap_matrix_scaled)] <- 0
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3] <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

keep_metrics <- !rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled) %in% c("Fm", "Fo", "fm", "fo", "F0", "FM")
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[keep_metrics, , drop = FALSE]

metric_id_column <- if ("Metric_Code" %in% names(metric_families)) {
  "Metric_Code"
} else if ("Metric" %in% names(metric_families)) {
  "Metric"
} else {
  stop("metric_families must contain a Metric_Code or Metric column.")
}

if (!"Family" %in% names(metric_families)) {
  stop("metric_families must contain a Family column.")
}

annotation_row <- metric_families %>%
  transmute(
    Metric = .data[[metric_id_column]],
    Family = as.character(Family)
  ) %>%
  filter(Metric %in% rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)) %>%
  distinct(Metric, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Metric")

missing_families <- setdiff(rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled), rownames(annotation_row))
if (length(missing_families) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Metric families are missing for: ",
    paste(missing_families, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
annotation_row <- annotation_row[rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled), , drop = FALSE]

sorted_order <- order(annotation_row$Family)
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[sorted_order, , drop = FALSE]
annotation_row <- annotation_row[sorted_order, , drop = FALSE]

phenotype_map <- c(
  "Cluster_1" = "Phenotype II",
  "Cluster_2" = "Phenotype I",
  "Cluster_3" = "Phenotype III",
  "1" = "Phenotype II",
  "2" = "Phenotype I",
  "3" = "Phenotype III"
)

phenotype_colors <- c(
  "Phenotype I" = "violet",
  "Phenotype II" = "orange",
  "Phenotype III" = "cyan"
)

sanger_colors <- c(
  "Confirmed" = "#000000",
  "Unconfirmed" = "#F0F0F0"
)

sample_metadata <- data.frame(SampleID_clean = original_labels) %>%
  left_join(meta_filteredK2, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    Site = case_when(
      grepl("^Site", as.character(Site)) ~ as.character(Site),
      !is.na(site_rename_map[as.character(Site)]) ~
        unname(site_rename_map[as.character(Site)]),
      TRUE ~ as.character(Site)
    ),
    Phenotype = factor(
      phenotype_map[as.character(K_3)],
      levels = c("Phenotype I", "Phenotype II", "Phenotype III")
    ),
    `D. trenchii (Sanger)` = ifelse(
      SampleID_clean %in% confirmed_trenchii_ids,
      "Confirmed",
      "Unconfirmed"
    )
  )

if (anyNA(sample_metadata$Species) || anyNA(sample_metadata$Phenotype)) {
  stop("Sample metadata could not be matched to every dendrogram label.")
}

annotation_col <- sample_metadata %>%
  select(
    SampleID_clean,
    Phenotype,
    `Host Species` = Species,
    `D. trenchii (Sanger)`
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

ann_colors <- list(
  Family = metric_colors,
  Phenotype = phenotype_colors,
  `Host Species` = species_colors,
  `D. trenchii (Sanger)` = sanger_colors
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = my_hclust,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "darkred"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101),
  main = "MAPP Fluorescence Phenotypes & D. trenchii Presence",
  filename = here("Plots", "MAPP_Phenotype_Heatmap_Sanger.pdf"),
  width = 13,
  height = 10
)
```

```{r ggtree}
meta_tree <- sample_metadata %>%
  mutate(
    Site_Label = Site,
    Sanger_Dtrenchii = `D. trenchii (Sanger)`
  )

p_tree <- ggtree(my_hclust) %<+% meta_tree +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(shape = Species, fill = Species),
    size = 3,
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, name = "Host Species") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = species_shapes, name = "Host Species") +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(title = "Photophysiological Phenotypes & D. trenchii Occurrence")

df_site <- meta_tree %>%
  select(SampleID_clean, Site = Site_Label) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

p1 <- p_tree + new_scale_fill()
p1 <- gheatmap(
  p1,
  df_site,
  offset = 10,
  width = 0.04,
  colnames_angle = 90,
  colnames_offset_y = 0.5
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_colors, name = "Site")

df_sanger <- meta_tree %>%
  select(SampleID_clean, `D. trenchii (Sanger)` = Sanger_Dtrenchii) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

p2 <- p1 + new_scale_fill()
p2 <- gheatmap(
  p2,
  df_sanger,
  offset = 25,
  width = 0.04,
  colnames_angle = 90,
  colnames_offset_y = 0.5
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sanger_colors, name = "D. trenchii (Sanger)")

df_pheno <- meta_tree %>%
  select(SampleID_clean, Phenotype) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

p_final <- p2 + new_scale_fill()
p_final <- gheatmap(
  p_final,
  df_pheno,
  offset = 40,
  width = 0.04,
  colnames_angle = 90,
  colnames_offset_y = 0.5
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phenotype_colors, name = "Phenotype")

ggsave(
  here("Plots", "Phenotype_Dendrogram_ggtree.pdf"),
  plot = p_final,
  width = 13,
  height = 10
)
```
